programme.desc: Dr. Phil's interview with death row inmate Rodney Reed continues. Reed's attorney, Bryce Benjet tells what he thinks happened to Stacey. Retired NYPD detective Kevin Gannon & criminologist Dr. Lee Gilbertson say they know who killed Stacey & how.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Samantha & sister Sarah say mom, Stacy, is a successful teacher & behaviorist, but when it comes to 33-year-old brother, Ben, it's another story. Stacy says teaching Ben how to pay bills and to eat his veggies helps Ben. Ben says he's just stuck in a rut.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: McKinley, 18, says she decided 5 years ago she never wanted to see her dad, Cory, again, after learning he went to jail on two counts of sexual battery of a minor! She says her dad is a violent, dangerous, "psychopath". Cory says he's never abused anyone.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Megan's ex-boyfriend Andy is trying to replace her as their 5-year-old son's mother with his new fiancée, Caitlin. Megan says Andy lied to the judge, falsely painting her as unfit, unstable & a drug addict. Andy says Megan's tale of woe is a sob story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melissa, 26, left home without warning & flew 2,000 miles across the country, leaving behind a note that said, "One day, Dr. Phil will be able to help me." The family says she hadn't "been herself." Melissa says she's ready to tell why she vanished.

programme.title: To A Safer Place
programme.desc: To a Safer Place" follows Shirley Turcotte's journey as an incest survivor. Returning to her past, she confronts family violence with courage. Her story inspires survivors to find healing and dignity through frank disclosures.

programme.title: Benoit
programme.desc: Benoît is an astonishingly accomplished eleven-year-old Québécois from Joliette. He pursues such diverse activities as weight lifting and playing the violin.

programme.title: Writer In The Nuclear Age A Conversation With Margaret Laurence
programme.desc: Margaret Laurence tackles peace-related issues in this short film: writer's social responsibility, language's impact, nuclear threat, and more. Ideal for sparking discussions across various subjects.

programme.title: Cornet At Night
programme.desc: This film recalls rural life on the Prairies in the 1930s. A farmer's young son, sent to town to hire a man for the harvest, readily accepts when an itinerant trumpet player, down on his luck, begs a chance.

programme.title: Undertaker For Life!
programme.desc: Undertakers are anything but gloomy; they’re funny, generous and dedicated. We would gladly go on vacation with them, but sadly, they never have any dead time.

programme.title: Moving On
programme.desc: Moving On examines the services needed by and available to battered women. This film looks at the problem of wife assault in London, Ontario, a rare model community that has effectively responded to the issue.

programme.title: Me And My Moulton
programme.desc: One summer in mid-’60s Norway, a seven-year-old girl asks her parents if she can have a bicycle. The film provides a glimpse of its young protagonist’s thoughts as she struggles with her sense that her family is different from what she sees as “normal”.

programme.title: Safe Distance, A
programme.desc: A Safe Distance examines the services needed by and available to battered women. The film looks at some innovative approaches to providing services and accommodation for battered women in rural, northern, and Native communities.

programme.title: Forgotten Warriors
programme.desc: Although they could not be conscripted, when World War II was declared, thousands of Indigenous Canadian men and women enlisted and fought alongside their non-Indigenous countrymen. They fought for freedom while being denied their own.

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives
programme.desc: Les intempéries peuvent réduire un cadavre à quelques amas d’os en seulement quelques semaines. En combinant l’art et la science, les anthropologues judiciaires redonnent un visage aux victimes longtemps après leur mort.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives
programme.desc: Près de 1,8 million d’Américains sont portés disparus chaque année. À l’échelle planétaire, ce nombre est trois fois supérieur. En plus de mettre des visages sur les cartons de lait et les vitrines des magasins.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives
programme.desc: Certaines victimes connaissent très bien leur meurtrier, ce qui en fait des cibles faciles car elles ne se méfient pas de lui. Heureusement, même si le meurtre a soigneusement été préparé, il reste toujours des traces de cet abus de confiance.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives
programme.desc: Il n’est pas facile d’inculper un criminel lorsque le corps de la victime a disparu mais les médecins-légistes y parviennent de plus en plus fréquemment.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives

programme.title: Doctor Who: Saison 6

programme.title: Doctor Who: Saison 6

programme.title: Doctor Who: Saison 6
